method: Assistant contextual LLM review; no trained classifier, no measured accuracy or calibrated confidence.
unit: sentence, interpreted with the original paragraph/article context
rules: Retain narrator evaluations/interpretive framing of exactly one side.
Exclude factual reporting and attributed/quoted opinions without narrator evaluation.
Exclude both and neither from retained files; preserve decisions in the audit.
Palestine covers Palestinian actors; evaluations of U.S. solidarity/protest movements are excluded from direct party groups and saved separately.
Israel covers Israeli actors/policies; Jewish identity alone does not imply an Israeli political position.
Narrative framing is not evidence of the author's personal beliefs. Loaded terms and analytical descriptions require interpretive review.
No equal category sizes were imposed. These outputs are candidate annotations, not a validated bias score.
